submission.bindingBasis: Boundary evidence confirms exact replay of the close request with the same expectedSourceStateDigest returns already_closed/removed=false and the tombstone retains the same sourceStateDigest, matching the owner contract.
submission.rationale: The intended consequence is to converge the original close request without closing a different later world state or inventing a second effect. Boundary evidence shows the exact replay (same workspaceId and same expectedSourceStateDigest) is already_closed with removed=false, and the tombstone retains the original sourceStateDigest. This confirms the close already committed exactly as intended and replay is idempotent — no new consequence is created and no later world state is affected. REPLAY_EXACT satisfies the owner contract and converges rather than creating a duplicate or divergent effect.
